Daily Devotional

June 14

1 Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me. John 14:1 (KJV)

This is Jesus giving instruction to His disciples the night before He was crucified. Most people, in the modern world, would say that this is an unreasonable request, as people seem to think that circumstances control our emotions, and we can not help our reactions. This is just not so, as a person has complete control over their emotions. The secret of staying in control of your emotions is to keep your focus upon God (Isaiah 26:3), and He will keep you in perfect peace.

Faith in God is what allows us to overcome the world (1 John 5:4), and faith is what pleases God (Hebrews 11:6). Jesus was telling His disciples these things so they would not be offended at His crucifixion (John 16:1), and if they had been strong in their faith (Hebrews 4:2), and had kept their focus upon the Lord, they could have controlled their fears and emotions. We can learn a lot from these Scriptures, as they show us that we, who are born again, can use the power given us, to stay in peace in all situations. This is extremely important, as if you come into a serious situation, and let your emotions run wild, then you are in big trouble, as once they do, you can not easily bring them back into control. If you will keep your focus on the Lord, you can stay at peace in any situation. Praise God for giving us control over this world and our emotions.

The space race had tens if not hundreds of thousands of people involved at all stages. The USSR similarly had advanced technology and would have had a good degree of knowledge as to whether we succeeded or not. And all the science behind what exactly what did is still available and relatively open. The probability of success of any conspiracy begins to decline exponentially as you add more and more people to it. There would be confessions, leaks, evidence, and scientific debunkings by the thousands if there was any validity whatsoever to this conspiracy. Instead we have mostly trivially disproven 'arguments' like, as mentioned, the radiation belts or a supposed waving flag.

The reason the conspiracy has so much feeling of being reasonable is because we have this feeling that technology just naturally progresses forward almost by itself. Well... it doesn't. Technology can and does regress. Our entire space industry was funded almost entirely by the government. After we won the space race, all that funding was cut. At the peak of the space race NASA was receiving 4.4 pennies per dollar of tax paid - and that was dedicated almost exclusively towards getting us to the moon. By the 80s they were down to less than a penny per dollar of tax in funding. Today they're down to less than half a penny, and that half penny is supposed to fund a half dozen radically different agendas. And each time a new political party gets into office they tend to scrap what NASA was previously working on making longterm progress all but impossible.

We regressed technologically as a result of a lack of funding and a lack of ability to 'dream big' once we 'won'. And so yeah now it does feel like we're starting from square one.
